rows.commentary: 6.2: Jacob Duffy forces Virat Kohli into an awkward defensive stance as unexpected bounce clips the edge harmlessly past the vacant gully region.
6.3: Jacob Duffy delivers a short-of-length ball that Ruturaj Gaikwad gently tucks toward mid-on before scampering through for a brisk single.
6.4: Jacob Duffy drops it short outside off, allowing Virat Kohli to slide onto the back foot and steer it smoothly down to third man.
6.5: Jacob Duffy serves a fullish delivery outside off, prompting Ruturaj Gaikwad forward where an inside high-bat connection trickles toward short cover.
6.6: Jacob Duffy digs it short outside off, and Ruturaj Gaikwad brilliantly swivels on the back foot to dispatch it soaring over mid-wicket for four.
7.1: Matthew Fisher tests the channel outside off, and Virat Kohli rides the bounce from the crease to steer it straight to backward point.
7.2: Matthew Fisher fires a pacy bouncer well outside off, leaving Virat Kohli to watch it sail through as Tim Seifert leaps to gather.
7.3: Matthew Fisher claims the prized scalp of Virat Kohli as a fierce 145kph slash catches the edge, allowing Tim Seifert to leap right and complete the dismissal.
7.4: Matthew Fisher angles a probing short-of-length ball into middle, forcing Shreyas Iyer back to push it solidly toward mid-on.
7.5: Matthew Fisher targets off stump with an angled delivery, and Shreyas Iyer calmly punches it off the back foot to the left of mid-off.
7.6: Matthew Fisher drifts too wide and high outside the tramlines, conceding an extra as Shreyas Iyer wisely watches it pass.
7.6: Matthew Fisher targets the off stump with a full angle, and Shreyas Iyer meets it ahead of the pitch to push toward mid-off.
8.1: Jacob Duffy strikes as Ruturaj Gaikwad feathers an inside edge through to Tim Seifert, who clings on sharply behind the stumps to remove the opener for 18.
18.2: Michael Bracewell flights this full on leg and middle, and Ishan Kishan strides forward to push it toward cover.
18.3: Michael Bracewell extracts sharp dip and turn outside off, prompting Ishan Kishan to angle an open-faced defense toward short third man before Axar Patel rescinds a hurried single.

18.4: Michael Bracewell delivers a full toss flicked toward backward square leg, resulting in mid-pitch hesitation and a desperate, tumbling dive at the striker's end to beat the high return to Tim Seifert.
18.5: Michael Bracewell tosses this up full on off stump, allowing Axar Patel to step forward and loft a straightforward drive down to long-on.
18.6: Michael Bracewell drops one on a good length onto leg-stump, where Ishan Kishan shifts back to tuck it neatly behind square on the leg-side.
19.1: Blair Tickner angles a sharp back-of-a-length delivery into off stump, beating the defensive push with a thick inside edge that deflects off pad to gully.
19.2: Blair Tickner slides a full delivery in on off, and Ishan Kishan meets it with the full face of the bat to return it safely to the bowler.
19.3: Blair Tickner bangs this short at pace, drawing an unsuccessful caught-behind appeal as Ishan Kishan lifts a leg to pull and catches only his back thigh.
19.4: Blair Tickner spears a length delivery into middle, met by a forward defensive prod from Ishan Kishan straight to short mid-wicket.
19.5: Blair Tickner serves up a fullish width outside off, brilliantly driven with an open face by Ishan Kishan past backward point and cover to race away to the boundary.
19.6: Blair Tickner responds with vicious seam movement off a length outside off, slicing sharply past the bat and flying just over the unprotected timber.
20.1: Michael Bracewell tosses up a full delivery on off stump, and Axar Patel drives it firmly toward the cover fielder.
20.2: Michael Bracewell drops it short outside off and Axar Patel stays back to slash it hard towards the cover fielder.
20.3: Michael Bracewell slides one flat on a good length at middle, prompting Axar Patel to drop back and nudge it into the mid-wicket region.
20.4: Michael Bracewell keeps it straight on middle without turn, allowing Axar Patel to rock back and punch it down to long-on for a single.
20.5: Michael Bracewell tosses up a slower, fuller delivery outside off, and Ishan Kishan strides forward to drill it wide of cover.
20.6: Michael Bracewell delivers a flat back-of-a-length ball outside off, which Axar Patel cuts off the back foot out to sweeper cover.
21.1: Blair Tickner is greeted instantly as Axar Patel dispatches the delivery searing away to the sweeper cover boundary.
33.6: Mitchell Santner slips a quicker one down leg, and Auqib Nabi cleverly glances it fine across the turf for four.
34.1: Michael Bracewell drops it on middle and leg, inducing an early front-edge from Ishan Kishan that dies right at the bowler's feet.
34.2: Michael Bracewell pulls his length back to test Kishan, who drives uppishly and just evades the reaching bowler's grasp for a single.
34.3: Michael Bracewell fires one in from outside off, catching the inside edge of Auqib Nabi's defensive prod.
34.4: Michael Bracewell offers flight on off stump, prompting Auqib Nabi to drop anchor deep in his crease defensively.
34.5: Michael Bracewell slides a flatter delivery onto the pads, allowing Auqib Nabi to tickle it behind square on the on-side for a run.
34.6: Michael Bracewell tosses it outside off, inviting Ishan Kishan forward into a secure defensive stride.
35.1: Mitchell Santner lobs up an inviting delivery on off, which Auqib Nabi steps back to smother toward the off-side.
35.2: Mitchell Santner outfoxes Auqib Nabi with clever drift, forcing a mistimed drive straight into the hands of Finn Allen at cover.
35.3: Mitchell Santner loops one up outside off, drawing Yash Thakur into a textbook forward defensive block.
35.4: Mitchell Santner darts a flatter ball past Yash Thakur's flashing blade as the batsman tries to carve it away.
35.5: Mitchell Santner angles one into middle and leg, beating Yash Thakur's tuck and bouncing safely off the pad.
35.6: Mitchell Santner extracts sharp turn and extra bounce from the surface, drawing a thick edge from debutant Yash Thakur that Tim Seifert safely gathers to complete a double-wicket maiden.
Mitchell Santner strikes twice in the over, leaving the batting side reeling at 167 for 8!
36.1: Michael Bracewell tosses it up on the off stump, allowing Ishan Kishan to punch it down the ground toward long-on for a comfortable opening single.
36.2: No run for Mohammed Siraj off Michael Bracewell.
41.6: Mitchell Santner floats it up, and Mohammed Siraj executes a clean sweep towards deep mid-wicket to smuggle four more crucial runs for India.
42.1: Jacob Duffy delivers the knockout blow with a clever off-cutter that bypasses Arshdeep Singh's bat to shatter the stumps, wrapping up India's innings at 209 and claiming his third wicket.
0.1: Arshdeep Singh charges in at 130kph, angling one in from a length to allow Will Young to nudge it towards backward square leg for an easy opening single.
0.2: Arshdeep Singh tests the channel outside off with a hint of inward movement, leaving Tim Seifert entirely unbothered as he watches it die before the keeper.
0.3: Arshdeep Singh showcases immaculate seam position, and Tim Seifert plays it late, dead-batting the sharp in-swinger down toward mid-on.
0.4: Arshdeep Singh attacks the pads on a length, inviting Tim Seifert to clip it smoothly away to the square leg fielder.
0.5: Arshdeep Singh offers a tempting half-volley wide of off, but Tim Seifert fires his drive straight into the hands of the fielder at cover.
0.6: Arshdeep Singh pulls his length back with some inward curl, forcing an inside edge off Tim Seifert's punch that trickles toward square leg for a single.
9.4: Mohammed Siraj comes angling round the wicket to fire a pinpoint yorker at the toes, and Nick Kelly does brilliantly to jam it out of harm's way.
9.5: Mohammed Siraj misses his mark with the fuller length outside off, and Nick Kelly creams a gorgeous square drive through point for four, holding the pose.
9.6: Mohammed Siraj slides one across, and Nick Kelly plays it late, opening the face to steer a single past backward point.
10.1: Auqib Nabi digs it in short, but the delivery sails way over Nick Kelly's head for a wide.
10.1: Auqib Nabi pulls back his length on off stump, and Nick Kelly pushes it solidly back down the pitch to the bowler.
10.2: Auqib Nabi angles a short-of-a-length delivery across the left-hander, and Nick Kelly cuts it crisply to deep point for a single.
10.3: Auqib Nabi drops one on a short of good length outside off, allowing Will Young to tuck it through square leg for a single.
10.4: Auqib Nabi pitches it up, and Nick Kelly inside-halves his drive through mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
10.5: Auqib Nabi drifts a back-of-a-length delivery wide of off, which Will Young steers square on the off-side for a single.
10.6: Auqib Nabi bangs it in short and wide, watching as Nick Kelly ducks his head and sways out of the line to let it pass.
11.1: Yash Thakur tumbles on his followthrough after striking the seam outside off to extract extra bounce, catching the high part of Will Young's bat as he defends.
11.2: Yash Thakur finds a hesitant edge from Will Young on a wide good-length delivery, racing past the vacant slips and beating third man to the boundary.
11.3: Yash Thakur clips the woodwork with his trailing boot in the delivery stride, gifting Will Young a free hit after a stock defensive prod into the off-side.
11.3: Yash Thakur spears it full and wide, allowing Will Young to reach out and punch a single through the covers.
11.4: Yash Thakur targets the ribs with a sharp delivery, and Nick Kelly works it off the back foot toward the leg-side.
11.5: Yash Thakur finds a good length outside off, clipped by Nick Kelly through the inner half toward mid-on for a brisk single as Shreyas swoops in with a wayward shy at the non-striker's stumps.
11.6: Yash Thakur drifts it slightly fuller outside off, prompting Will Young to stride across and dead-bat it into the off-side.
20.6: Arshdeep Singh delivers on a good length outside off, and Finn Allen opens the bat-face to steer it down to third man for a single to get off the mark.
21.1: Mohammed Siraj bowls short of a length that nips back into middle, forcing Finn Allen onto the back foot to defend toward mid-wicket.
21.2: Mohammed Siraj fires it full and angles it onto middle, where Finn Allen steps forward and softly turns it to the leg side.
21.3: Mohammed Siraj strikes with a cracking delivery from wide of the crease that nips back to find the gap between bat and pad, shattering the top of Finn Allen's off-stump.
21.4: Mohammed Siraj sends down a length ball angling away outside off, and Michael Bracewell comfortably shoulders arms.
21.5: Mohammed Siraj switches to round the wicket, pitching short of a length outside off for Michael Bracewell to punch off the back foot toward the covers.
21.6: Mohammed Siraj completes a wicket-maiden with an off-pace good length ball outside off, offering Michael Bracewell an easy leave.
22.1: Arshdeep Singh attacks on a short of length, angling into off-stump for Dean Foxcroft to press forward and defend toward mid-off.
22.2: Arshdeep Singh serves it fuller outside off, inviting Dean Foxcroft to reach out and drive straight to the fielder in the covers.
22.3: Arshdeep Singh targets outside off with a short of length that nips away after angling in, allowing Dean Foxcroft to leave alone.
22.4: Arshdeep Singh digs it back of a length to nip into the fifth-stump channel, prompting Dean Foxcroft to jab it away to the left of cover.
22.5: Arshdeep Singh keeps it short of a length and angled at off, and Dean Foxcroft gets right behind the line on the back foot to block.
22.6: Arshdeep Singh completes the maiden as Dean Foxcroft offers no stroke to the away-seamer outside the off stump.
23.1: Mohammed Siraj tests Michael Bracewell with a wide full delivery that the left-hander toe-ends off the front foot toward the slips.
23.2: Mohammed Siraj concedes a boundary as Michael Bracewell drives powerfully through to the deep extra cover fence.
32.1: Auqib Nabi pitches it full outside off, Mitchell Santner leans back to drive, and the thick inside edge thuds into his left leg before rolling toward cover.
32.2: Auqib Nabi targets full outside off, Mitchell Santner steps forward to open the face of the bat and safely guides it to backward point.
32.3: Auqib Nabi serves up a full delivery outside off, and Mitchell Santner strides forward to drive it out to sweeper cover for a single.
32.4: Auqib Nabi hits a length outside off that holds its line, leaving Kristian Clarke pushing forward to defend and narrowly beating the outside edge.
32.5: Auqib Nabi delivers a good length ball angled into off with two slips waiting, prompting Kristian Clarke to drop onto the back foot and line up a defensive push to cover.
32.6: Auqib Nabi pushes wide of the crease, angling a probing good length ball in to beat Kristian Clarke on the forward defensive.
33.1: Yash Thakur fires a full delivery angled into off, and Mitchell Santner gets forward to punch his on-drive straight to mid-on.
33.2: Yash Thakur drops it short of a length just outside off, and Mitchell Santner moves onto the back foot to punch it toward cover.
33.3: Yash Thakur drops a short ball outside off after inspecting the turf, and Mitchell Santner steps back to tap it toward backward point.
33.4: Yash Thakur bowls full outside off, allowing Mitchell Santner to stride forward and punch a drive wide of cover for a single.
33.5: Yash Thakur hits a short of length outside off, prompting Kristian Clarke to drop back and punch past an empty gully region.
33.6: Yash Thakur comes from over the wicket with a short of length delivery on middle, and Mitchell Santner gets right behind the line for a compact back-foot block.
34.1: Auqib Nabi angles from wide of the crease, nipping one back sharply into Kristian Clarke to strike the thigh pad high above the stumps.
34.2: Auqib Nabi offers a full delivery outside off, and Kristian Clarke drives cleanly past a sluggish mid-off fielder to race away for four.
34.3: Auqib Nabi bangs it short outside off, allowing Kristian Clarke to work the ball backward of point with an angled bat for a single.
34.4: Auqib Nabi targets a back of a length that nips toward off, prompting Mitchell Santner to ride the bounce and pat it straight down the pitch.
34.5: Auqib Nabi delivers on a good length outside off that stays low, sneaking beneath Mitchell Santner's forward defensive prod.
44.2: Axar drops it flat, allowing Jacob Duffy to punch a single cleanly down to long-on.
44.3: Blair Tickner uncorks a massive heave outside off but meets only thin air.
44.4: Axar Patel jams it into the stumps, and Blair Tickner heaves it through mid-wicket to take a single.
44.5: Duffy retreats into his crease to counter the rapid arm ball, nurdling it toward cover.
44.6: Axar widens his line, drawing another defensive prod from Duffy straight to the cover fielder.
45.1: Siraj steams in at 136kph and bangs it short, leaving Tickner swinging wildly at emptiness.
45.2: Mohammed Siraj charges in to bowl a length delivery to Blair Tickner, who relies on his bottom hand to work the ball through mid-wicket for a single.
45.3: Siraj drops it into a shortish zone, inviting Duffy to swipe a single out to deep mid-wicket.
45.4: Tickner survives a chaotic run-out check after a relay throw finds him scrambling back just in time.
45.5: Tickner gets a thick outside edge past a diving Kishan, sending a streaky boundary racing to the ropes.
45.6: Siraj spears it full outside off, and Tickner can only slice his drive straight to backward point.
46.1: Axar lands it on a length outside off, and Duffy cuts it crisply to backward point.
46.2: Axar Patel delivers full, Jacob Duffy holes out straight to Virat Kohli at long-on, sealing the dismissal as India close in on victory.
46.3: Axar Patel fires it in, and Matthew Fisher gets firmly behind the line to push it toward cover for a dot.
46.4: Axar Patel drifts it in on a flat trajectory, and Matthew Fisher plays a watchful defensive stroke to the fielder at cover.
46.5: Matthew Fisher does not score off Axar Patel.
46.6: Axar Patel pushes it through on a length, and Matthew Fisher works it away past cover off the back foot to rotate the strike.
47.3: Yash Thakur digs it in short, and Matthew Fisher miscues his pull over mid-wicket to sneak a single.
47.4: Yash Thakur follows the backing-away Blair Tickner with a sharp bumper that trickles off a bottom edge to the keeper on the bounce.

47.5: Yash Thakur oversteps the crease once more, flashing the bails in his delivery stride to gift Blair Tickner a free-hit, before Tickner backs away and drags an inside edge safely short of Ishan Kishan.
47.5: Yash Thakur cleverly rolls his fingers across a short free-hit delivery as Blair Tickner swings wildly and misses entirely.

47.6: Yash Thakur strikes that heavy length once more, drawing a mishandled swipe from Blair Tickner toward mid-wicket for a single as the debutant completes a fine spell yielding one for thirty-eight.

48.1: Axar Patel fires it flat and angling in to seal a 3-1 series victory, as Blair Tickner charges down the pitch, misses the low delivery entirely, and leaves Ishan Kishan ample time to whip off the bails.
